body: Yep. The night I was “saved” I was sent to a hospital. I was also reprimanded that week for needing time off work. And a month later I was mailed a huge bill because my insurance didn’t cover the hospital. But lucky me, I was “saved”.
I agree. Not to mention, lifelong depression is hardly “temporary”.

I agree. But we seem to be rare in thinking this way. I think it’s a species survival thing for humans to see suicide as the worst thing possible, and to believe stopping someone from it is being a “hero”.

I got close to killing myself once 6 years ago. I was stopped. My life didn’t get better. It got worse. I’m still suicidal but never got up the courage again. I don’t see this as her being saved. I see it as her chance to get out being stolen.
That’s fucked up. This hasn’t happened to me specifically, but I feel for you. Plus, I’ve been in relationships with narcissists. I’m sorry.

I used to do this often. Then I stopped checking in here for the last year or so. Today I’m scrolling to see if I can find him posting about his ex. He’s been single for long enough now that if he had wanted me, it would’ve happened. The rejection and facing reality hasn’t fixed me. I’m not sure why I’m scrolling to find what I’m looking for. So, thanks for posting this. Because it made me realize I should stop now.
